definition.simple: When two or more LEGO blocks (atoms) stick together, they form a molecule.
definition.academic: A molecule is the smallest particle of a substance (element or compound) that has an independent existence and retains all the properties of that substance.

common_misconceptions: Molecules and atoms are the same thing.
Molecules can only be formed from atoms of different elements.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: If an atom is a single letter, what is a molecule? (Answer: A word made of letters).
